code='''def transform(grid):
    # Recover the color at each crossing of the overlaid horizontal and vertical grid lines.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    rs = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) > 1 and len(set(grid[r])) <= 3]
    cs = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) > 1 and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) <= 3]
    a = [[grid[r][c] for c in cs] for r in rs]
    # The outside frame is not part of the encoded picture.
    return [row[1:-1] for row in a[1:-1]]
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
